sources.title: UR5 Pick and Place - GitHub
sources.snippet: The robot is able to pick up a bottle from a table and place it on another table (and also give the dummy a drink 😁 🍺). The computer vision part of the project is implemented via a CNN. The CNN is trained to detect the bottle position on the image. sources.snippet: A UR5e robotic arm model was created in MATLAB and used to write the word "FLOW". A quintic spline interpolation method was implemented to generate the end-effect trajectories.
